title: Resourse Singularity
description: Resource Singularity — a grind-heavy mod in the style of Avaritia. No energy, no machines — just a crafting table, compression, new ores, alloys, and weapons. Start with a stick. Compress it. Craft an Enderium. Reach the Block of Infinity
body:
Resource Singularity is a mod about endless grind, complex crafting chains, and the pride of making it to the end.

No RF, no pipes, no energy multiblocks. Just you, a crafting table, a furnace, and dozens of compression levels.

Start with a stick. Compress it into a reinforced stick. Then into a super stick. Then into a singularity stick. Then into an absolute stick. The final level — the Stick of Infinity — requires 59,049 ordinary sticks.

New ores have been added: tin, titanium, mithril, adamantine. From them, you will craft nickel, invar, silver, copper/gold/adamantine wires, redstone crystals, and quantum dust.

Weapons: Star Light Sword (16 damage), Adamantine Sword (11 damage), Quantum Cutter (28 damage, ignores 50% of armor).

The path to enderium: Nether Star → Star Dust → Quantum Dust → Enderium.

Planned: 5 development stages, ether crystals, singularity core, Block of Infinity, and new monsters.

This mod is not for the faint of heart. Are you ready to compress, craft, and grind for hundreds of resources?

Resource Singularity. From a stick — to infinity.
